lifetime_contracts: One installed service on the Gx owner/current-context thread; retained worker performs file reads and BLP decode.
Cache holds no extra handle reference; same canonical name/sampler shares a request.
Close last handle: clear GPU bindings/storage, retire entry and cancel ticket; current-read ownership lasts through exactly one completion.
Service stops image admission before draining its callbacks; close all file handles before service, then device/context/queue.
Native tickets never occupy CTexture::m_asyncObject or impersonate CAsyncObject.
remaining_limits: Mip zero, BLP2 version 1 palette/raw/DXT1/3/5 converted to RGBA8. Original Gx power-of-two dimensions, minimum 8x8 and device limits.
Explicit sampler flags 1/9, nearest/linear and wrap U/V. 32 live images and 32 undelivered requests; 32 MiB sources, 2,097,152 base pixels, up to 256 MiB completed cached pixels.
Frame 0x17 flags, wait mode 2, mip defaults/anisotropy, texture atlases, alternate/TGA paths, blob/substitution/streaming and legacy async adaptation remain unavailable.
Actual Frame factories/font/string/layout/input and original GlueXML/login execution/rendering remain open.

No new physical-input, Windows runtime, macOS graphics, server session, Warden outcome or gameplay acceptance. Server image-tag/embedded-revision discrepancy and interactive user sign-in preference remain unchanged.
